name: glyhub_GPST000585_N
title: Bladder-tissue N-glycans across cancer stages
description: N-glycan profiles from healthy bladder, cystitis and Ta, T1 and muscle-invasive bladder tumours. The table contains five observations in each of the first four groups and eight in the muscle-invasive group.
details: PNGase F-released, reduced and permethylated N-glycans were quantified by mass spectrometry. Source Table S1 relative-abundance values are preserved without rescaling; paired peak areas are retained in row annotations rather than duplicating the dataset. n.d. cells are missing. Composition identities and source glycan classes are preserved without converting class labels into asserted structures.
annotation: Source-derived composition annotations; linkage information is retained as source annotation without inferring a full topology. No complete unambiguous structures are asserted.
